question: How many Gold medals India won in the Olympics between 1928 and 1980?
solution:
The correct answer is __**8.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India won a total of **8 Gold medals** in the Olympics between **1928 and 1980.**
 
• India won its** first Gold medal **in 1928 in Amsterdam in **Men's Field Hockey.**
 
• India won another **7**** Gold medals** in **Men's Field Hockey** in 1932, 1936, 1948, 1952, 1956, and 1964,1980
 
• **1928 Amsterdam: **Gold medal

 **1932 Los Angeles: **Gold medal

 **1936 Berlin:** Gold medal

 **1948 London:** Gold medal

 **1952 Helsinki:** Gold medal

 **1956 Melbourne:** Gold medal

 **1964 Tokyo:** Gold medal

 **1980 Moscow:** Gold medal

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tokyo, Japan **hosted the **2020 Summer Olympics,** an international multisport competition, from **July 23 to August 8, 2021.**
 
• Since India's first official Olympics participation in 1920, the 2020 Summer Olympics have been the most successful for the country, with** seven medals **won by Indian athletes **(one gold, two silver, and four bronze)**.
 
• The upcoming international multi-sport event known as the **2024 Summer Olympics** is slated to occur in France from **July 26 to August 11, 2024,** with Paris serving as the primary host city.
 
• At the **131st IOC Session** in Lima, Peru, on September 13, 2017, **Paris **was granted the Games.
